# Chimera II OS Consolidation Manifest

## Published in GitHub

The initial public repository now contains the unified README, build definition, public C API, RegisterN 4096/8192-bit arithmetic primitive, bootinfo ABI, host simulator, HTTP simulation server, tests, Koronos scheduler scaffold, Kore service scaffold, Spotnik ownership scaffold, Aurora desktop overview, Aurora Wayland interface, Spit Fire x86 MBR research stub, integration notes, and project governance files.

## Historical project material

The complete local consolidation also contains additional Aurora renderer source blocks, Spotnik AF_XDP source blocks, web UI assets, boot/Jasper configuration, extracted research source, reference documents, and original source-package archives. These are preserved in the local `ChimeraIIOS-source.zip` deliverable generated during this session.

## Why the manifest exists

GitHub's connected contents interface used in this session accepts UTF-8 text files but does not expose a bulk local-directory upload operation. Therefore this first publication pass uploads the principal source and architecture files directly and preserves the complete consolidated tree as the companion local archive rather than silently dropping historical material.

## Status vocabulary

- **Published:** directly present as a repository file.
- **Preserved:** present in the complete local consolidation archive.
- **Prototype:** research/scaffold code; not production-safe OS code.
